errors.evidence: The description details the percentages for the "All Changes" chart but completely omits the values for the "All Errors" chart (P: 56%, PW: 3%, R: 29%, RW: 6%, N: 1%, NW: 5%).

errors.text_span: no slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offset, or bolding
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. In both pie charts, several slices (PW, RW, N, and NW) are clearly offset or exploded from the main circle.

errors.text_span: A legend to the right of the charts provides a key to the colors used for each category. The charts do not feature a traditional legend
errors.evidence: This is a contradictory statement. It correctly identifies the legend on the right, and then incorrectly states that the charts do not have a traditional legend.
